content: Use Seedance 2.5 with 480p resolution and a 15-second duration for generating a wide-area fixed aerial long-shot combat scene (上空ロングショット 俯瞰視点 広域 定点撮影 戦闘シーン).

en.content: Use Seedance 2.5 with 480p resolution and a 15-second duration to generate a wide-area fixed aerial long-shot combat scene (aerial long shot, bird’s-eye view, wide area, fixed camera, combat scene).
